name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: Host-side `MaskInfo` preprocessing (`_process_mask`) in JAX Pallas SplashAttention currently slices and materializes every `(q_block, kv_block)` tile via `np.ndindex` and iterates in Python over all blocks in `_get_mask_info_for_shard` and `_shrink_mask_info` / `_shrink_mask_info_dkv`. For long-context masks (8k-131k tokens), this takes tens of seconds on CPU during tracing.

head_commit.message:
Host-side `MaskInfo` preprocessing (`_process_mask`) in JAX Pallas SplashAttention currently slices and materializes every `(q_block, kv_block)` tile via `np.ndindex` and iterates in Python over all blocks in `_get_mask_info_for_shard` and `_shrink_mask_info` / `_shrink_mask_info_dkv`. For long-context masks (8k-131k tokens), this takes tens of seconds on CPU during tracing.

This mirrors the equivalent optimization recently merged in Tokamax (https://github.com/openxla/tokamax/pull/1986).

This change:
- Adds `_classify_mask_blocks` (and `_q_block_stats`) to classify `FullMask`, C-contiguous `NumpyMask`, `CausalMask`, `LocalMask`, `ChunkedCausalMask`, `LogicalOr`, and `LogicalAnd` blocks analytically (`0` = empty, `1` = partial, `2` = full, `-1` = unresolved fallback to per-block slicing).
- Skips `_HashableNDArray` deduplication of partial blocks when `mask_function is not None`, as `MaskInfo` discards `partial_mask_blocks` and `mask_next` when the mask is computed inside the kernel.
- Adds a fast path in `_process_mask` when all heads share the same `Mask` object reference (`head_mask is first_mask`).
- Vectorizes `_get_mask_info_for_shard` using `np.flatnonzero` and `np.searchsorted` for both `is_dkv=False` and `is_dkv=True`.
- Vectorizes `_shrink_mask_info` and `_shrink_mask_info_dkv` across all head shards simultaneously using `np.nonzero` and `np.cumsum`, removing `_slice_mask_info`.
- Adds parameterized unit tests in `tpu_splash_attention_mask_test.py` verifying equivalence between lazy and dense `MultiHeadMask` instances across square and non-square mask/block shapes (`(16, 16)`, `(16, 32)`, `(32, 16)` with block shapes `(4, 4)`, `(4, 8)`, `(8, 4)`), heterogeneous multi-head masks, sharded grids, `is_dkv=True/False`, and non-contiguous `q_sequence` configurations.

name: Bazel ROCm
display_title: Add fast path for jnp.asarray on arrays

head_commit.message:
Fix jnp.asarray fast path for concrete tracers

`isinstance(x, Array)` is true for tracers with array avals, so the new
fast path returned concrete JVPTracers/GradTracers unchanged. Those still
need `_convert_element_type` to stage scalar primals into arrays, which
made `jax.jvp(jnp.asarray, (1.0,), (1.0,))` return Python floats.

Exclude tracers from the new fast path and add regression tests for
jvp, linearize, and vjp.

head_commit.message:
Fix `NaN` check in `lax.linalg._unpack_conjugate_pairs`.

`w.imag == np.nan` is always `False`, shifting conjugate-pair `cumsum` parity when a `NaN` eigenvalue precedes a complex pair. Use `lax._isnan(w.imag)` instead (matching CPU `UnpackEigenvectors`).

head_commit.message:
Avoid redundant PRNG work in `jax.random.gumbel` (`mode="highest"`).

In `float32` `mode="highest"`, the `threefry2x32` PRNG work in `_gumbel` was duplicated since `threefry2x32` already outputs two `uint32` words per hash, but `_random_bits(..., shape=(2,) + shape)` collapsed each pair into one word and ran twice as many hashes.

Fix this by drawing `(hi, lo)` directly as two `*shape` streams via `prng.random_bits(..., num_streams=2)` and hoisting `-jnp.log` out of `jnp.where` to make it easier for XLA to fuse ops while avoiding duplicate PRNG work.

Also, gate the `num_streams=2` path to multi-stream PRNGs (`num_streams >= 2`, i.e., `threefry2x32`, `threefry4x32`, `philox`), and update legacy `threefry2x32.threefry_raw_bits` (`threefry_partitionable=False`) to use a single `(2, *shape)` pass so legacy `gumbel` streams stay bitwise identical and other `num_streams=2` callers avoid a split plus two passes.
